id.label: ID
id.help: Used in the product's URL and in every cart and order line. Do not change it once the product has sold.

title.label: Title
title.help: The product's name, as buyers see it.

sku.label: SKU
sku.help: Your own stock code. Copied onto each order line.

status.label: Status
status.help: Only an active product can be added to a cart.

type.label: Type
type.help: A digital product never ships, and can deliver files after payment.

price.label: Price
price.help: Unit price in the store currency. Used when the product has no variants, and as the default for a variant without its own price.

compareAtPrice.label: Compare-at Price
compareAtPrice.help: Shown as the crossed-out price. Display only; never charged.

taxable.label: Taxable
taxable.help: Charge tax on this product when the store charges tax.

requiresShipping.label: Requires Shipping
requiresShipping.help: Ask for a shipping address and charge shipping. Ignored for a digital product.

weight.label: Weight
weight.help: In your own weight unit. Not used by the built-in shipping rates; kept for extensions.

trackInventory.label: Track Inventory
trackInventory.help: Count stock down as orders are paid. On a subscription it counts seats, taken once when the subscription starts.

stock.label: Stock
stock.help: How many are left. Used when the product has no variants.

allowBackorder.label: Allow Backorder
allowBackorder.help: Keep selling when stock reaches zero.

images.label: Images
images.help: Product photos. The first is the main image.

description.label: Description
description.help: The product description shown on its page.

variants.label: Variants
variants.help: The options a buyer chooses between, such as sizes or a monthly and a yearly plan. A product with variants is always bought as one of them.

deliverables.label: Downloadable Files
deliverables.help: Digital products only. Buyers get expiring links after payment. These files are never served by the public download routes.

category.label: Category
category.help: Groups products in your catalog, and can limit a discount code.

tags.label: Tags
tags.help: Free-form labels for filtering your catalog.

meta.label: Fulfillment Data
meta.help: Free-form JSON copied onto each order line at purchase, for code that fulfills the order. Example: {"edition":"pro"} for a license product.

billing.label: Billing
billing.help: A subscription is billed by the payment provider every interval until it is cancelled. A subscription cannot be a product that ships.

interval.label: Every
interval.help: How often a subscription is billed.

intervalCount.label: Interval Count
intervalCount.help: 3 with Month means every 3 months. At most 3 years, 36 months or 156 weeks.

trialDays.label: Free Trial Days
trialDays.help: Subscriptions only. The first charge comes after the trial. 0 means no trial; 730 at most.

accessGroup.label: Grants Access Group
accessGroup.help: The buyer joins this group, so the buyer must have an account. A subscription keeps them in it while it is active; a one-time purchase keeps them in it unless it is refunded. The groups offered are set in Settings → Commerce.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: When the product was last saved.
